_comment: Administrative facts for Path A that are not in the unit or degree data,
because neither institution publishes them on the handbook pages the
scrapers read. Every value carries the page it came from and the year it
applies to, so the comparison stays computed from recorded data rather than
The two institutions publish tuition on different bases: Sydney per year at
a 48 credit point full-time load, UTS per session. Normalising them is the
engine's job and needs the credit point totals it already holds.

domestic_commonwealth_supported.funding_cluster: Cluster 3 (Engineering, Surveying, Environmental Studies or Science), non-grandfathered
domestic_commonwealth_supported.note: The Commonwealth caps this amount, so it is the same at both institutions for the same discipline. It differentiates the two degrees only through their differing credit point totals.

international_tuition.field: Engineering and computer science, undergraduate guide fee

known_gaps: The international figures are for different years: Sydney publishes 2026 and the current UTS international table is 2027. UTS does not publish a 2026 equivalent any longer, so the comparison is reported with both years stated rather than adjusted.
Both institutions describe their international fees as indicative.
Domestic full-fee (non-Commonwealth-supported) places are not recorded, because neither degree normally offers one to a domestic undergraduate.
